placeholder.title: facturar
placeholder.body: Quotes, invoices, credit notes and payments in guaraníes — with timbrado, per-rate IVA and WhatsApp delivery.
placeholder.status: Scaffold in place. The database lands in PR-2.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask your company's administrator to set a new one for you.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.body: Change your password whenever you like.
changePassword.forced: An administrator set a new password for your account. Choose your own to continue.

errors.invalid: We could not change the password. Check the details.
errors.wrong: The current password does not match.
errors.too_common: It is too easy to guess.
errors.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

users.title: Users
users.body: Add your team and decide what each person can do. Permissions are checked on the server, not only on screen.
users.name: Name
users.initialPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. Hand it over in person or by WhatsApp — they will be asked to change it when they sign in.

messages.passwordReset: Password set. They will be asked to change it when they sign in.

errors.taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.notFound: We could not find that user.
errors.lastAdmin: At least one active administrator must remain.
errors.too_common: It is too easy to guess.
errors.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.

dashboard.intro: This is where what needs your attention today lives: overdue invoices, quotes to follow up and timbrado warnings.

empty.title: Nothing urgent today
empty.body: No overdue invoices and no quotes waiting. A good moment to write a new one.

setup.title: Add your timbrado before you invoice
setup.body: No invoice can be issued without a valid timbrado. Add its number, validity window and authorised range.

settings.title: Company details
settings.intro: These details are printed on every quote and invoice you issue.
settings.companyHint: Name, RUC and contact details that appear on your documents.
settings.rucHint: With its check digit, for example 80012345-0.
settings.defaultCurrencyHint: Used when creating a new document; you can change it per document.
settings.logoUrlHint: An https:// address for your logo. File upload arrives once storage is in place.

links.timbradosBody: Number, validity window and authorised range for issuing invoices.
links.usersBody: Your team and what each person can do.

errors.wrong_dv: The check digit does not match.

timbrados.title: Timbrados
timbrados.intro: The timbrado authorises your numbering. Without a valid one with numbers left, no invoice can be issued.
timbrados.startAtHint: Leave empty to start at the beginning of the range. Set only when the timbrado is added.
timbrados.createHint: Copy the details exactly as they appear on the DNIT authorisation.
timbrados.label: Timbrado {number} · {establishment}-{point}

empty.title: No timbrado added yet
empty.body: Add its number, validity window and authorised range so you can issue invoices.

alerts.blocked: You cannot issue invoices with this timbrado

errors.notFound: We could not find that timbrado.
errors.before_start: It must come after the start.
errors.out_of_range: It must fall inside the authorised range.
errors.already_issued: You cannot narrow the range below numbers already issued.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Your customer list. The RUC and WhatsApp number stored here are the ones printed on every document.
customers.name: Name or company name
customers.rucHint: Including the check digit, for example 80012345-0.
customers.whatsappHint: Type it any way you like: 0981 123456 or +595 981 123456.
customers.docLocaleHint: The language this customer's quotes and invoices are issued in.
customers.createHint: A name and a RUC are enough to send them a quote.
customers.deactivateHint: Customers are never deleted — they stay on the invoices already issued. Deactivating just hides them from the list.
customers.readOnly: Your role can view customers but not change them.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.body: Add your first one with a name and a RUC. You can then issue quotes and invoices to them.

noResults.title: No customer matches that search
noResults.body: Try part of the name, the RUC without its check digit, or include inactive customers.

errors.notFound: That customer could not be found.
errors.malformed: That does not look like a valid number.
errors.wrong_dv: The check digit does not match the RUC.
errors.not_mobile: This must be a mobile number, not a landline.

products.title: Products and services
products.intro: Your price list. Anything stored here becomes a quote or invoice line in one click.
products.name: Name
products.descriptionHint: Printed on the document line, under the name.
products.unitHint: How it is charged: per unit, per hour, per m².
products.unitAmountHint: The final price, IVA included, exactly as your price list shows it.
products.taxRateHint: 10% for most goods and services; 5% for basic foodstuffs and rent; exempt for what is not taxed.
products.createHint: Enter the price with IVA included, the way you quote it to a customer.
products.deactivateHint: Products are never deleted — they stay on the documents already issued. Deactivating just removes them from the catalogue.
products.readOnly: Your role can view the catalogue but not change it.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Add what you sell with its final price and IVA rate. You then pick it from a list when building a quote.

noResults.title: No product matches that search
noResults.body: Try part of the name or description, or include inactive products.

errors.notFound: That product could not be found.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.intro: Build a quote, send it over WhatsApp, and turn it into an invoice when the customer accepts.
quotes.newIntro: Pick the customer, add the lines, and set how many days it is valid for.
quotes.docLocaleHint: The language the PDF is printed in and the message is sent in.
quotes.missingBaseUrl: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is not set, so this link will not work outside this machine.
quotes.notesHint: Printed on the PDF: delivery terms, payment details, anything worth stating.
quotes.editHint: You can edit it until the customer accepts or rejects it.
quotes.convertHint: Creates a draft invoice with every line. Issuing it against a timbrado, with a number, arrives with the invoices module.

empty.title: No quotes yet
empty.body: Add a customer and a few products, then build your first one in under a minute.

messages.converted: Draft invoice created with every line.

errors.notFound: That quote could not be found.
errors.notEditable: A quote that has been accepted or rejected cannot be edited.
errors.badTransition: That status change is not allowed.
errors.alreadyConverted: This quote has already been turned into an invoice.
errors.notAccepted: Mark the quote as accepted first.

documentPdf.ivaIncludedNote: IVA is included in the amounts shown.
documentPdf.notAnInvoice: This document is not an invoice.

documentShare.quote: Hello {name}, here is your quote for {total}. You can view it here: {link}
documentShare.invoice: Hello {name}, here is your invoice for {total}. You can view it here: {link}

publicDocument.expired: This quote has expired. Ask us for an updated one.
publicDocument.ivaIncludedNote: IVA is included in the amounts shown.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Once issued against a timbrado, an invoice is never touched again. Corrections go through a credit note.
invoices.newIntro: Enter the lines as a draft. The number is taken only when you issue it.
invoices.creditDaysHint: How many days the customer has. The due date is calculated when you issue.
invoices.docLocaleHint: The language the PDF is printed in and the message is sent in.
invoices.issueHint: Issuing takes the next number from the timbrado and closes the invoice.
invoices.issueWarning: This cannot be undone: fixing it afterwards needs a credit note.
invoices.immutableBody: It can no longer be edited or deleted. If something is wrong, issue a credit note against it.
invoices.notesHint: Printed on the PDF: payment terms, bank details, anything worth stating.
invoices.editHint: Until you issue it, everything can still change.

empty.title: No invoices issued yet
empty.body: Build a draft with its lines and issue it when it is ready. You can also convert an accepted quote.

messages.issued: Invoice issued. The number has been taken from the timbrado.

errors.notFound: That invoice could not be found.
errors.immutable: An issued invoice cannot be edited. Correct it with a credit note.
errors.noLines: An invoice needs at least one line.
errors.noTimbrado: You have no valid timbrado to issue against. Add one under Settings.
errors.numbering: The number could not be taken. Please try again.
errors.blocked_not_yet_valid: That timbrado is not valid yet.
errors.blocked_range_exhausted: That timbrado has no authorised numbers left.
errors.blocked_sequence_out_of_range: The numbering has fallen outside the authorised range.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Everything received, newest first. Payments are recorded from each invoice.
payments.hint: Record each payment with its method and reference.
payments.none: Nothing has been paid against this invoice yet.
payments.referenceHint: Transfer id, cheque number or wallet reference.

empty.title: No payments recorded yet
empty.body: When an invoice is paid, record the payment from the invoice and it will show up here.

errors.notFound: That invoice could not be found.
errors.future: A payment cannot be dated in the future.
errors.payment_voided: That invoice has been voided by a credit note.
errors.payment_exceeds_outstanding: The amount is more than is still owed.
errors.payment_wrong_currency: The payment must be in the invoice's currency.
errors.payment_not_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.hint: The only way to correct an issued invoice.
creditNotes.none: This invoice has no credit notes.
creditNotes.warning: A credit note is issued with its own number and cannot be edited afterwards either.
creditNotes.notesHint: Printed on the PDF: a return, a billing error, a later discount.
creditNotes.immutable: A credit note is never edited or deleted.

errors.notFound: That invoice could not be found.
errors.noTimbrado: You have no valid timbrado to issue against. Add one under Settings.
errors.numbering: The number could not be taken. Please try again.
errors.credit_already_voided: That invoice is already fully voided.
errors.credit_exceeds_invoice: You cannot credit more than the invoice total.
errors.credit_not_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.credit_wrong_currency: A credit note must be in the invoice's currency.
errors.blocked_not_yet_valid: That timbrado is not valid yet.
errors.blocked_range_exhausted: That timbrado has no authorised numbers left.
errors.blocked_sequence_out_of_range: The numbering has fallen outside the authorised range.

send.emailDisabled: Email sending is not configured yet. Use WhatsApp or the link.
send.noEmail: This customer has no email address on file.

errors.notFound: That document could not be found.
errors.noEmail: This customer has no email address on file.
errors.noLink: This document has no public link.
errors.email_rejected: The provider rejected the message. Check the customer's address.
errors.email_network: The email provider could not be reached. Please try again.

history.empty: Nothing has happened with this document yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: The IVA liquidation and the period's sales, in the shape your accountant asks for.
reports.exportHint: The files are semicolon-separated and open straight in Excel. Amounts are unformatted so they can be summed.

empty.title: No documents were issued in this period
empty.body: Change the period or issue an invoice — quotes and drafts do not appear in the report.
